name: average-rent-data
description: Read apartment asking rents, market statistics, and price history with source links.

interface.longDescription: Compare tracked apartment asking rents across US markets. Find apartments by city, state, ZIP code, or property name. Read unit prices, fees, concessions, and observed price changes with source links and verification dates. Results describe tracked listings and do not confirm current availability. Connect your Average Rent account to use its data allowance.
defaultPrompt: Compare two-bedroom asking rents in Austin and Dallas.
Find apartments in ZIP code 78704 under $2,000.
Compare the tracked Texas rent sample with the national sample.

positive.prompt: Compare two-bedroom asking rents in Austin and Dallas.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_market_stats for the tracked Austin and Dallas city slugs. Compare the two-bedroom asking-rent sample only when both samples contain data. Report sample counts and returned dates. Cite source URLs. Explain missing data without inventing a result.

positive.prompt: Find apartments in ZIP code 78704 under $2,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_apartments with zip 78704 and max_rent 2000. Show returned listings with asking rents, source links, and verification dates, or explain that no tracked listings match. Do not claim confirmed current availability.

positive.prompt: Compare the tracked Texas rent sample with the national sample.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_national_summary with state TX. Compare returned Texas and national statistics. Report sample sizes and dates. Explain that the national sample covers tracked listings and does not represent all US rental homes.

positive.prompt: Find one tracked apartment building in Austin and show its unit asking rents, fees, and verification date.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Austin first. Read one returned property ID with get_property. Show returned prices, fees, source links, and verification date. Qualify past listings when no_current_availability is true. Explain missing fees without inventing charges.

positive.prompt: How many data calls do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_account_usage for the connected review account. Show its remaining shared data allowance and UTC reset time. Consume no data call and promote no subscription or checkout.

negative.prompt: Sign a lease and pay a deposit for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin reads apartment data and cannot sign leases or make payments. Call no transaction tool and request no payment credentials.

negative.prompt: Give me signed lease prices for every rental home in the United States.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin covers asking rents from tracked apartment listings. It cannot provide signed lease prices for all US homes. Invent no complete coverage or signed lease data.

negative.prompt: Use only this plugin's get_market_stats tool to read Austin rents while my Average Rent account is disconnected. Do not use web search or another app.
negative.expected_behavior: In a fresh unlinked installation, attempt get_market_stats for Austin. Show the account-connection sign-in prompt or explain that the protected tool requires account linking. Read no protected rent data and reserve no data call. Do not request a password or token in the conversation. A public page or another app does not establish an authenticated result from this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.7 adds the owner's review walkthrough URL. It preserves the eight review cases, average-rent-data identifier, and rent-only connection settings. Public directory review and approval remain pending.
